name: Zoe Krupka
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I'm a feminist psychotherapist, supervisor, lecturer and writer in Melbourne, Australia. I am a senior lecturer in the Master of Counselling and Psychotherapy Program at the Cairnmillar Institute and work part-time in private practice. My work is informed by a deep interest and commitment to anti-oppressive practice, existential theory and practice and by my training in psychodynamic and Process- Experiential Emotion-Focused Therapy.

title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Chad Loftis is an experienced clinical counsellor registered at the highest level with the ACA and PACFA. He is trained as a narrative therapist and has been practicing since 2006. He has specialised training in couples therapy, trauma healing and crisis debriefing.

name: Cody Fisher
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hi there. I offer a warm, inclusive, and trauma-informed space where individuals, groups, and communities can explore identity, creativity, and healing. As a queer therapist, I value visibility, affirmation, and creating safe, empowering spaces. I work with people of all ages and identities, offering individual therapy, group programs, and creative workshops that honour diverse lived experiences. 🖌️ LGBTQIA+ inclusive 🌀 NDIS-friendly (self & plan-managed) 📍 Wollert, Melbourne’s outer north (community outreach available) 💻 Online sessions available
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy
